decision: All three runtime variants rejected; only analysis and evidence integrated.
problem: Repeated strict canonical recognition on current inline bytes dominates repeated complex JSON shapes.
invariant: Current scoped MVCC/Entity reads, materialization, source verification and original admission/reader/witness quotas always precede reuse. Fingerprints only index candidates; tenant/owner and full byte equality establish completed proof reuse. Errors, legacy conversion, contention and poison keep the original parser. Pending entries cannot certify anything.
alternatives: Delay full byte retention until second successful parse.
Future resource-budgeted admission sketch; not implemented or certified.

resource_scope: Additional experimental inline capacity: blockCacheBytes/64/2; existing blob capacity unchanged. Base 4096 +1024 per entry +actual boxed bytes conservatively accounted. Eviction precedes allocation. Whole-process RSS/HWM/threads remain in SDK rows; accounting is not RSS. No workers, persistent formats or durable growth added.
decision_basis: Latest long escaped/array latency reductions 45.26%/41.72%, CPU 42.98%/40.11%; 2000 unique cold-array latency regresses 2.35%, CPU 4.24%. 2000 pending entries plus two completed proofs account 2063456 bytes. Mixed performance defeats adoption.
causal_limit: Digest, eligibility, admission and code/allocation layout vary together. Metadata insertion is a next testable hypothesis, not a proven exclusive cause. No observer timings or finite comparison establish all-scenario SQLite superiority.
verification_scope: 20/21/21 canonical tests and 13 document-neighbor tests per source. Separate observer current values/versions across writes with 198/198/196 completed proof reuses. No full native/app release gate. Initial invalid observer secret and corrected runs retained.
